sqlStatements: DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'anon') THEN CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'service_role') THEN CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN; END IF; END $$
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO anon, authenticated, service_role
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA neon_auth TO authenticated, service_role
